title: QEDConfig
description: Configuration schema for Q.E.D. Mechanical Verification Engine

ignorePatterns.description: Array of glob patterns or directory paths to exclude from linter scanning

excludeDirs.description: Additional directory names to skip during recursive source file scanning

extensions.description: Additional file extensions to treat as code and inspect (e.g. ['.kt', '.swift', '.php'])

scratchPatterns.description: Custom regex patterns or substrings for temporary files to ban in repository root (QED001)

secretPatterns.description: Custom regex patterns for high-entropy secrets and access tokens to flag (QED007)

rules.description: Map of rule identifiers to their enforcement severity ('error', 'warn', 'off')

QED001.description: PRISTINE_ROOT: Zero temp dumps, logs, or scratch files in root

QED002.description: ZERO_DEBUG: Zero console.log, debugger, print(), fmt.Println

QED003.description: EMPTY_CATCH: Zero empty catch blocks or swallowed exceptions

QED006.description: UNBOUNDED_CACHE: Ban on exported module-level unbounded Map/dict

QED007.description: SECRET_LEAK: Zero hardcoded tokens, API keys, or private keys

QED009.description: DIV_ONCLICK: Semantic <a> links instead of <div onClick>

QED011.description: UI_EMOJI_SLOP: Ban on emoji salad in UI buttons and headers
